name: Screen-Door Transparency with Importance Compositing
definition: A rendering technique that connects feature importance to spatial sampling density using screen-door transparency. Focus features are rendered densely, while context features are rendered sparsely if they occlude focus features, or densely otherwise.
summary: Screen-Door Transparency with Importance Compositing is a volume rendering technique that dynamically adjusts sampling density and opacity based on feature importance to prevent less important features from occluding critical ones.
